claims: No. 2 seed Iowa defeated No. 15 seed Fairleigh Dickinson 58-48.
The game was a 2026 NCAA Women’s Tournament first-round game.
The game took place on March 21, 2026.
Ava Heiden led Iowa with a career-high 29 points.
The game was at Carver-Hawkeye Arena.
Ava Heiden scored 29 points for Iowa.
Hannah Stuelke scored 13 points for Iowa.
Hannah Stuelke had 16 rebounds for Iowa.
Fairleigh Dickinson are led by coach Stephanie Gaitley.
Fairleigh Dickinson entered with a 22-game winning streak.
The game was played in high heat at Carver-Hawkeye Arena, noted by both teams.
Iowa advances to play 10th-seeded Virginia in the second round.
